message.content: The minor allele (C) at SNP **rs7412**—which defines the APOE ε2 allele—is found in roughly **12–15 %** of individuals of European ancestry. In the gnomAD v2.1.1 dataset, the allele frequency in the “Non-Finnish European” subset is about **0.13** (≈13 %). This figure is consistent with other large-scale studies of European cohorts, which report ε2 frequencies ranging from 11 % to 16 %.
